sbs.privacy.tab.title: Privacy & data
sbs.privacy.tab.intro: By default this mod sends nothing about you. Each switch below turns on one thing, and one thing only.
sbs.privacy.tab.nothing_preticked: Nothing here is ticked for you. You can close this screen without allowing anything.
sbs.privacy.button.website.describe: Opens the SkyBlock Simplified website in your normal web browser, outside Minecraft. Minecraft will ask you to confirm first, and lets you copy the address instead of opening it.
sbs.privacy.label.notice: The full privacy notice ships with the mod as PRIVACY.md, and the legal notice as LEGAL-NOTICE.md. Both are in the mod's repository.
sbs.privacy.label.contact_website: Questions, complaints and data protection requests: info@codecreative.store, or our Discord.
sbs.privacy.label.stored: Your answers are stored per Minecraft account in config/sbs/license/privacy/ and are shared by every config profile.
sbs.privacy.label.details_hint: Hover a row to see exactly what it sends, who receives it and how long it is kept.
sbs.privacy.support.title: Support & bug reports
sbs.privacy.button.discord: Open the SBS Discord (opens your browser)
sbs.privacy.button.discord.describe: Opens the SkyBlock Simplified Discord invite in your normal web browser, outside Minecraft. Minecraft will ask you to confirm first, and lets you copy the address instead of opening it.
sbs.privacy.label.discord_disclaimer: For help and bug reports. Discord is a third-party service and opens in your browser - anything you send there is handled by Discord under its own terms and privacy policy, not by us. It is NOT a channel for privacy or data protection requests: use the contact details on the website for those, so you never need an account anywhere to exercise a right.
sbs.privacy.state.planned.tooltip: There is nothing behind this switch in this version - no data is sent for it. It is listed so you can see it exists and what it will do. Available in a future update.
sbs.privacy.state.lapsed: What this covers has changed - please read it again and decide.
sbs.privacy.scope.licence_validation.dat: Your licence token and the mod version.
sbs.privacy.scope.licence_validation.why: To confirm your subscription is valid. This is what you paid for, so it has no switch - saying no to it means not using the paid features at all.
sbs.privacy.scope.licence_validation.ret: For as long as your licence exists, plus what tax law requires us to keep for the purchase itself.
sbs.privacy.scope.licence_validation.dec: Not applicable. To stop this, remove your licence token - the mod then contacts no SBS server at all.
sbs.privacy.scope.irc_identity.title: Community chat identity
sbs.privacy.scope.irc_identity.data: Your Minecraft name and the messages you send in community chat.
sbs.privacy.scope.irc_identity.why: So your name appears next to your messages, and so moderators can act on abuse: attribute a message to an account, mute or ban someone who keeps at it, and handle reports from other players.
sbs.privacy.scope.irc_identity.recipient: The SBS backend, and every other SBS user in the chat.
sbs.privacy.scope.irc_identity.retention: Messages are held for 24 hours for moderation and are never replayed to other players. Moderation records are kept for 30 days.
sbs.privacy.scope.irc_identity.decline: Community chat is off. You cannot send or receive it. Nothing else is affected.
sbs.privacy.scope.badge_public.title: SBS badge above your name
sbs.privacy.scope.badge_public.data: Your Minecraft UUID, sent every 30 seconds while you play.
sbs.privacy.scope.badge_public.why: So other people running SBS can see the SBS badge next to your name.
sbs.privacy.scope.badge_public.recipient: The SBS backend, and in effect EVERY other SBS user - not only friends or party members. Anyone running the mod can find out that your account uses it.
sbs.privacy.scope.badge_public.retention: About two minutes. It is held in memory only and is dropped if you stop playing.
sbs.privacy.scope.badge_public.decline: No badge appears above your name for other people. You still see your own.
sbs.privacy.scope.presence_self.title: Online status and lobby
sbs.privacy.scope.presence_self.data: Nothing is sent for this in this version.
sbs.privacy.scope.presence_self.why: Intended for showing friends and party members that you are online and which lobby you are in.
sbs.privacy.scope.presence_self.recipien: Would be the SBS backend and the people you share a party or friends list with.
sbs.privacy.scope.presence_self.retentio: Nothing is stored, because nothing is sent.
sbs.privacy.scope.presence_self.decline: Nothing changes - there is no such feature yet.
sbs.privacy.scope.presence_nearby.title: Detecting nearby SBS users
sbs.privacy.scope.presence_nearby.data: Nothing. Earlier versions uploaded the UUIDs of players around you; that has been removed.
sbs.privacy.scope.presence_nearby.why: So the mod can show which players near you also run SBS. It is being rebuilt the other way round: your client will download the list of people who allowed their badge to be public and compare it on your own machine, so nothing about anyone standing near you is ever sent to us.
sbs.privacy.scope.presence_nearby.recipi: Nobody. The comparison happens on your computer.
sbs.privacy.scope.presence_nearby.retent: Nothing is stored, because nothing is sent.
sbs.privacy.scope.presence_nearby.declin: Nothing changes. Until the new version ships, no badges appear over other players.
sbs.privacy.scope.party_finder.title: Party finder
sbs.privacy.scope.party_finder.data: Your name and UUID, the party you are in, and the requirements and SkyBlock stats a party is filtered on.
sbs.privacy.scope.party_finder.why: So parties can be listed, matched to the requirements you set, and shown to other players looking for one.
sbs.privacy.scope.party_finder.recipient: The SBS backend, and other SBS users browsing the party list.
sbs.privacy.scope.party_finder.retention: A party is removed 30 minutes after its last activity. Stats looked up for filtering are cached for 15 minutes.
sbs.privacy.scope.party_finder.decline: The party finder is unavailable. Hypixel's own party system is unaffected.
sbs.privacy.scope.carry_tickets.title: Carry tickets
sbs.privacy.scope.carry_tickets.data: Your Minecraft name, and the tickets you open, claim or comment on.
sbs.privacy.scope.carry_tickets.why: So carriers and customers can find each other on the shared ticket board.
sbs.privacy.scope.carry_tickets.recipien: The SBS backend, and other SBS users viewing the board.
sbs.privacy.scope.carry_tickets.retentio: Closed tickets are deleted 24 hours after they close.
sbs.privacy.scope.profile_data.title: Profile, item and stat lookups
sbs.privacy.scope.profile_data.data: Your SkyBlock profile id, data derived from your inventory and collections, and any player name you look up with the profile viewer.
sbs.privacy.scope.profile_data.why: So the server can work out your stats, value your items and calculate flips for you. Items sent for valuation have their unique item id and timestamp stripped first.
sbs.privacy.scope.profile_data.recipient: The SBS backend. It fetches from the Hypixel API on your behalf using its own key.
sbs.privacy.scope.profile_data.retention: Looked-up profiles are cached for 15 minutes. Item valuations are not stored against your account.
sbs.privacy.scope.profile_data.decline: Item appraisal, the profile viewer and personalised flips are unavailable. Plain market prices still work - those need nothing about you.
sbs.privacy.scope.hollows_structures.dat: The id of the Crystal Hollows lobby you are in (such as mini24CD), which structure you walked into, its centre and the box you walked around inside it, how many positions that box was built from, and your mod version. Never your name, UUID or chat.
sbs.privacy.scope.hollows_structures.why: So other SBS players in the same lobby see where the Jungle Temple, Mines of Divan and the other structures are, and you see theirs. The Crystal Hollows are rebuilt every few hours, so a location only means something inside one lobby.
sbs.privacy.scope.hollows_structures.rec: The SBS backend, and every other SBS user who is sharing in the same lobby. They see the structure and its position, never who reported it.
sbs.privacy.scope.hollows_structures.ret: Not stored anywhere yet: the server for this is not deployed, so the client's ticket request is refused and nothing else is sent. The retention period will be stated here once the server enforces one.
sbs.privacy.scope.hollows_structures.dec: No connection is opened and nothing is shared or received. The Crystal Hollows map still marks the structures you find yourself.
sbs.privacy.scope.diagnostics.title: Crash diagnostics
sbs.privacy.scope.diagnostics.data: Nothing is sent for this in this version.
sbs.privacy.scope.diagnostics.why: Intended for sending stack traces and version numbers so crashes can be reproduced and fixed. No player data would be included.
sbs.privacy.scope.diagnostics.recipients: Would be the SBS backend only.
sbs.privacy.scope.diagnostics.retention: Nothing is stored, because nothing is sent.
sbs.privacy.scope.diagnostics.decline: Nothing changes - there is no crash reporter yet.
sbs.privacy.migration.title: SkyBlock Simplified: your privacy settings
sbs.privacy.migration.body: This update adds per-purpose control over what the mod sends. Everything starts switched off, including features that used to be on. Open Licence Token > Privacy & data to choose.
